purpose: Daily CPU/GPU price reconciliation, stock verification and standardized 100-point scorecards for the 2026 Black Friday PC purchase

cpu.interpretation: 同一配点で比較。Cities: Skylines II等のシミュレーション、制作・分析、消費電力、購入目標価格、AM5継続性、販売証拠を評価。

gpu.interpretation: WQHD性能スコア、CUDA/ROCm/oneAPIの実用互換性、VRAM、性能スコア÷TGPの効率proxy、購入目標価格、保証/在庫証拠を評価。

score_policy.performance_per_watt_proxy: 2026-11-11 GPU comparison score divided by published TGP; not a measured wall-power benchmark
score_policy.provisional_unknown_price_rule: 価格が未確認の候補はprice_vs_targetを中立7/15とし、必ず暫定と明記する。
score_policy.note: Daily CPU/GPU comparison scores are distinct from the repository's existing full-build score, component fit score and dynamic purchase-evidence score. Do not compare these scales as if they measure the same thing.
